author: Zintenka
body:
Ah new map style! *Gasps* I thought you only made grassy tree maps Zintenka!

Well this one is different guys! Its snowy! And has a kit system similar to Axis! Remember how fun that map was?


Features:
  • 50vs50
  • Classes
  • Xp bottles and food for every kill.

Well there are 4 kits:
Cannoneer: For those of you TNT advocates out there like me, this is your go to kit! Has saturation IV (Extra food bars)

Rusher: For those of you speedy guys out there that like to ruin my TNT fu-- I mean... that like to get the monument as fast as you can this is the kit for you! Comes with speed I but Weakness IV.

Defender: Want to defend and prolong the game with nigh limitless supplies? Well, this is for you! Regeneration I, health boost I, and saturation IV

Juggernaught: The heaviest and most powerful of all the classes. Strength 1, slowness III, health boost 4.

YML

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Ok, there are a lot of questions regarding the kit thingy :P

Well, remember Axis for those of you who have played it at the time when it was in the rots?

Well the concept is similar. Click a button with the sign showing the class you wish to chose. 

After you click it, you are teleported below the kit room.

In front of spawn, there are 3 buttons. 2 of them is used for re entering spawn to either switch your kit or refilling your kit's items. 

1 of them teleports you to the center monument tower. From there, you travel up the water and go protect the monument. 

Please see the OP for the kits available.
